tools.name: trendaz_whoami
tools.description: Report which Trend News Agency access tier this connection has, which tools it may call, and what its request budget is. Call this first when a Trend tool is refused or returns less than expected — it distinguishes "not permitted at your tier" from "no such data".

tools.name: trendaz_coverage_get
tools.description: Describe what the Trend News Agency archive covers: which language editions exist and their canonical hosts, which regions and beats the agency reports on, and the terms under which its text may be used. tools.name: trendaz_news_list
tools.description: List Trend News Agency headlines newest first, optionally narrowed by section, tag, author or a date range. tools.name: trendaz_article_get
tools.description: Fetch one Trend News Agency article in full: headline, byline, dateline, publication date, section, tags and the body as markdown. tools.name: trendaz_trending
tools.description: List the most-read Trend News Agency articles of the last day, week or month, ordered by readership rather than by date. Use it for "what is Trend's audience paying attention to" — a different question from "what is the latest news", which is trendaz_news_list.

tools.name: trendaz_page_get
tools.description: Fetch one of Trend News Agency's own standing documents in full: its corrections policy, editorial standards, masthead, ownership and contact details, terms of service, privacy and cookie policies, copyright terms, and the published auditor reports. tools.name: trendaz_author_get
tools.description: Look up a Trend News Agency journalist by name, id or profile alias, and get what the agency publishes about them: role, the beats they cover, biography, stated expertise, declared conflicts of interest and whether they are staff. Use it when a citation needs to establish who reported something and

tools.name: trendaz_research
tools.description: Search Trend News Agency's archive and read the relevant part of each result in one call. tools.name: trendaz_subscription_plans
tools.description: What a Trend News Agency subscription costs and what it gives access to: the monthly and annual price in manat, dollars and euro, any introductory offer, and the link to subscribe. tools.name: trendaz_taxonomy_search
tools.description: Find the section slug for a subject or a country, so the other tools can be narrowed correctly. Matches on title and slug — "Kazakhstan", "energy", "casia" — and returns the slug to pass as the section argument, along with the public URL of that section. findings.detail: Description of "trendaz_page_get" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
